description: van der Zanden, Joep and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. MARIN publishes the early-design-stage wave-basin test results for a multi-body floating photovoltaic system protected by an external floating breakwater. The SUREWAVE programme schedules early understanding tests and later verification tests; this resource explicitly covers the early stage only. The sparse basin-results report links to this dataset by a native relation. Its own native communities contain only the general European collection, so no SUREWAVE community membership is asserted. Exact sensor channels, scaling and test conditions are unspecified. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The native file inventory establishes deposited data, but values and linked file bodies were not read. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
